jobs.title: Technical Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
**Turn technical insight into real\-world impact. Help leading brands understand their energy use, reduce waste and make their buildings perform better.**


At Best.Energy, we make buildings smarter, more efficient and more sustainable. Our energy monitoring and control technology gives organisations the insight they need to reduce costs and take meaningful action towards net zero.


We’re looking for a **Technical Sales Engineer** who combines technical understanding with commercial confidence. Someone who can understand a customer’s challenges, identify the right solution and build a compelling case for investment across multiple sites.

**The Details**


UK\-based, with hybrid working


£60,000\+ base salary with OTE of £120,000\+


Permanent, full\-time


Regular UK\-wide travel required for customer meetings and site visits

**About the Role**


You’ll help organisations turn complex energy challenges into practical, commercially sound solutions. Working with senior decision\-makers, technical teams and operational stakeholders, you’ll connect what our technology can do with the results that matter to each customer.


We’re particularly interested in experience within multi\-site hospitality and working with global brands, where solutions need to deliver value at individual locations and across an entire estate.


From initial discovery and site visits through to proposals, negotiations and contract signature, you’ll combine a consultative sales approach with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly. You’ll work closely with our technical and delivery teams to ensure proposals are achievable and customers experience a smooth handover.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and convert technical sales opportunities, managing the process from discovery through to contract signature
* Understand customers’ buildings, operational priorities and energy challenges through detailed conversations and site visits
* Build relationships with senior commercial, finance, sustainability, facilities and engineering stakeholders
* Deliver tailored demonstrations and presentations that make technical solutions clear and relevant
* Work with technical colleagues to define suitable solutions and develop accurate proposals
* Build credible business cases covering potential energy savings, costs and return on investment
* Support multi\-site opportunities, from initial pilots through to wider estate rollouts
* Negotiate commercial terms that deliver value for the customer and protect business margin
* Maintain accurate CRM records, pipeline forecasts and opportunity updates
* Coordinate clear handovers to delivery teams, capturing agreed scope and customer expectations
* Travel throughout the UK to support customer engagement and sales progression

**What We’re Looking For**


✅ Proven experience in technical or solution\-led sales, with a track record of securing high\-value or complex contracts


✅ The ability to understand technical products and translate their capabilities into clear commercial benefits


✅ Strong discovery, presentation and negotiation skills


✅ Confidence engaging with both technical specialists and senior decision\-makers


✅ Commercial awareness and the ability to build credible, evidence\-led investment cases


✅ Strong organisation, accurate CRM management and ownership of your sales pipeline


✅ A collaborative, self\-motivated and results\-focused approach


✅ Willingness and ability to travel throughout the UK

**It would be particularly useful if you bring:**

* Experience selling energy management, energy efficiency or related building technology solutions
* Experience working with multi\-site hospitality businesses, such as hotel, restaurant or leisure groups
* Experience managing relationships with global brands and navigating complex buying processes
* An understanding of how successful site\-level pilots develop into wider portfolio rollouts


Experience in another high\-value technical sales environment is equally welcome if you can demonstrate transferable skills and an aptitude for learning our solutions.

**Life at Best.Energy**


We’re a fast\-paced, mission\-driven team, and we’re committed to supporting our people. Our benefits include:


✨ NEST pension scheme


✨ 33 days’ flexible holiday allowance, increasing with length of service


✨ Everyday Healthcare cashback plan


✨ Dedicated learning time


✨ Two volunteer days each year


✨ Enhanced parental and family leave


✨ Regular company\-wide events and opportunities to collaborate


We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace. If you enjoy connecting technical solutions with commercial opportunities and want your work to contribute to a more sustainable future, we’d love to hear from you.


If you require any adjustments during the application process, please let us know.

### **Company Overview**


Please visit http://Best.Energy for more information

jobs.title: Team Leader Solution Engineer, Enterprise Services - Bloomberg Financial Solutions
jobs.description:
We are Enterprise data services \- fast paced, agile, innovative, and growing. We are at the heart of where, change meets value, technology development, data and client relationships. Our vast selection of datasets, covering all asset types, with multiple delivery technologies and flexible scheduling mean our clients can get exactly the data they need, when they need it, in the format they prefer. Without us, they simply can’t operate.  

**The Role:**  

  

As a Team Leader you’ll be leading a team of passionate, motivated and highly technical Solution Engineers, who provide programming and best practice consultation directly to our internal and external clients for the integration of our Enterprise Data products and services. You’ll be a quick study, eager to develop your understanding of the Bloomberg Enterprise Products and our customer base, in order to lead your team on client engagements as well as provide a third tier of technical expertise for complex issues. You’ll drive the partnership at the management level with other teams to understand client requirements, communicate product improvements, and assist with all client development needs. You’ll lead the group on adopting and embracing our cultural and innovative best practices, solutions and guide your team to be able to quickly and accurately identify and address highly technical problems. You’re a programming and management professional who is personable, intelligent and analytical, able to get results by working closely with team members and colleagues around the organization but are also not afraid of getting your hands dirty and making independent decisions when the situation demands.  

  

  

**We’ll Trust You To:**  

  

* Lead a strong team of experienced client facing developers who are at the forefront of technical business engagements building credibility with our users and establishing Bloomberg as the premier technical service partner during the pre\-sale and in ongoing relationships


* Understand big picture roadmaps and strategies to achieve long term goals such as Digital Transformation, Cloud adoption and complex data integration.


* Collaborate with peers, sales, technical account managers and service delivery teams to drive critical client on\-boarding initiatives, technology partnerships and highly technical projects.


* Proactively identify ideas to help drive stronger product performance and implement those ideas from inception to completion.


* Build relationships with senior and executive level client technologists by speaking their language and relating to them at the solution and technology level


* Be creative in your approach to problems and curious about different paths we can take to success even more so when we run into roadblocks. You will need to apply your experience to help your team and our clients achieve their goals.

  

**You’ll Need to Have:**  

  

* Strong client facing experience, be presentable \& able to articulate complex technical concepts to all skill levels.


* Development leadership experience in guiding and mentoring highly technical team members and helping them to spot gaps and seize opportunities.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail and the ability to handle multiple technical streams/lead client engagements whilst collaborating across different teams


* 10\+ years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (Python, Java, C\+\+, C\#).


* Hands on experience with Big Data, Data Science and Public Cloud technologies is a plus.


* Bachelor's degree (preferably MSc) in Computer Science or Information Systems.


* Industry experience in development or implementation of real time market data applications and related API’s.


* Experience with other market data providers and their platforms is a plus


* Confident to work with clients ranging from application developers to CTOs.

  

**We’d Love to See:**  

  

* Exposure and understanding of Financial Data, especially Real Time Market Data is helpful


* Experience in architecting, designing and operationalization of large\-scale data and analytics solutions


* Knowledge of financial markets and levels of urgency for critical data needs


* Exposure to modular designs with a focus on reliability and scalability.


* Commercial Product development.

  

  

  

If this sounds like you.

jobs.title: Estimation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Build your engineering career in renewable energy**

Are you a Mechanical or Electrical Engineering graduate, or an early\-career engineer looking for your next opportunity?

Join Photon Energy, part of Project Better Energy, as an Estimating Engineer and put your technical and numerical skills to work on solar PV projects.

You’ll work closely with our sales and engineering colleagues to develop outline solar PV designs, calculate project costs and prepare customer proposals. You’ll help customers understand how their proposed system will perform, what it will cost and its expected return on investment.

As your experience grows, you’ll have the opportunity to work across Commercial New Build, Residential New Build and Commercial Retrofit projects.

**Your responsibilities**

* Understand customer requirements by working closely with the relevant sales colleague.
* Create outline solar PV designs, including design drawings and system performance simulations.
* Prepare accurate project estimates using our in\-house pricing tool.
* Produce clear customer proposals covering system design, price and expected return on investment.
* Attend customer meetings alongside sales and engineering colleagues when required.
* Represent the company professionally and promote its products and services.
* Follow company working practices, quality procedures, health and safety requirements, and relevant statutory and regulatory standards.

**What you’ll need**

* A Mechanical or Electrical Engineering degree, or an equivalent qualification.
* Confidence using AutoCAD and Microsoft Office.
* A basic understanding of renewable energy and enthusiasm for working in the sector.
* Strong numerical skills and close attention to detail when preparing designs and quotations.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to work well with customers and colleagues.
* Good organisation and time management, with the ability to prioritise tasks and meet deadlines.
* An appreciation of how accurate, efficient work contributes to customer satisfaction and commercial performance.

**This role is suitable for graduates and candidates with up to two years of relevant experience.**

**What’s in it for you?**

* Competitive salary.
* 37\.5\-hour working week, Monday to Friday.
* Flexible working once fully trained, with three days per week in the office.
* Reading as the preferred location, with Poole or Rochester also available.
* 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays.
* The opportunity to develop experience across a range of solar PV projects.

**About Project Better Energy**

At Project Better Energy, we’re on a mission to make renewable energy accessible to everyone. We are home to Project Solar UK, Project EV, Project CÜRV, EG Solar and Photon Energy. Together, we deliver high\-quality green technology products and services that support a net\-zero future.

**Interested? Apply with your CV through Indeed.**

At Project Better Energy, we value diversity of thought, background and experience. We are committed to fair and inclusive recruitment practices and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates. All hiring decisions are made on merit and capability.

Application question(s):

* Would you need sponsorship in the future?

Work authorisation:

* United Kingdom (required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:

**Senior Power System Engineer**
================================

  

National Grid is hiring a Senior Power System Engineer \- This position is based from our Warwick office however we offer flexible hybrid working options.


You will develop into a highly capable transmission planning engineer, building expertise in strategic network assessment, system modelling, and Net Zero network development while contributing to some of the most significant transmission investment decisions in Great Britain.


### **Job Purpose**


As a Senior Power System Engineer within the Net Zero Engineering team, you will lead the technical assessment of future electricity transmission network requirements to support the decarbonisation of Great Britain's energy system. You will play a key role in identifying network needs, assessing system capability, developing innovative solutions, and providing robust engineering evidence to inform major transmission investment decisions.


Working across National Grid Electricity Transmission, NESO, customers, regulators, and industry stakeholders, you will lead strategic studies that support long\-term network development, enabling the integration of renewable generation, large\-scale demand growth, electrification, and emerging technologies.


You will combine advanced power system engineering expertise, modelling, analytics, and strategic thinking to ensure the future network can deliver Net Zero outcomes safely, efficiently, and economically.


### **What You'll Do**


* Lead strategic network planning studies to identify future transmission system needs and reinforcement requirements.
* Lead boundary capability assessments and transfer capability studies to assess future network constraints and opportunities.
* Develop technical recommendations to support transmission investment decisions and business cases.
* Assess the impact of generation, storage, demand growth, data centres, hydrogen, electrification, and emerging technologies on transmission system capability.
* Develop, model and evaluate innovative network solutions, including topology optimisation, flexibility services, HVDC, FACTS, and other system\-wide interventions.
* Translate complex technical analysis into clear strategic recommendations for senior stakeholders.
* Lead development of modelling methodologies, analytical tools, and data\-driven approaches to network planning.
* Provide technical leadership for innovation projects relating to future network operation and Net Zero delivery.
* Build strong relationships across National Grid, NESO, Ofgem, customers, and wider industry organisations.
* Mentor and coach engineers, supporting capability development across the team.
* Champion engineering excellence, governance, and compliance with industry standards and licence obligations.
### **About You**


**Essential**


* Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Significant experience in transmission planning, strategic network planning, system studies, or power system analysis.
* Strong understanding of:
* Power system analysis and modelling.
* Transmission planning methodologies.
* Boundary capability and transfer assessments.
* Network investment appraisal and cost\-benefit assessment.
* Future energy scenarios and system planning processes.
* Strong working knowledge of:
	+ NETS SQSS
	+ Grid Code
	+ CUSC
	+ Relevant transmission planning standards
* Experience using power system analysis tools such as PowerFactory, PSS®E, PSCAD, or equivalent.
* Excellent problem\-solving and critical\-thinking skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to influence technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

**Desirable**


* Experience in tCSNP, ETYS, NOA, SSEP, CSNP, or similar network planning processes.
* Experience in Python, DPL, optimisation techniques, data analytics, or automation.
* Knowledge of probabilistic assessment techniques and Monte Carlo analysis.
* Understanding of HVDC, FACTS, power electronics\-dominated networks, and system operability challenges.
* Chartered Engineer status or working towards Chartered status.
### **What You'll Get**


A competitive salary dependent on capability


Plus Market Suppliemnt Annual £4,500


As well as your base salary, you will receive a bonus based on personal and company performance and a competitive contributory pension scheme where we will double match your contribution to a maximum company contribution of 12%. You will also have access to a number of flexible benefits such as a share incentive plan, salary sacrifice car and technology schemes, support via employee assistance lines and matched charity giving to name a few.

  

The closing date for this vacancy is 14th October. However, we encourage candidates to submit their applications as early as possible and not to wait until the published closing date. National Grid’s recruitment periods can and may vary. We reserve the right to remove this advert or close it to further applications at any point during the recruitment process.


In NGET we are passionate about both operating our network safely and providing highly reliable quality of supply for our customers. At the heart of achieving these outcomes is the effective control and operation of our network.


To find out more , please follow the link below:


https://www.nationalgrid.com/electricity\-transmission/
